consigne_scene: Wide view inside a small rural motorbike repair workshop with a single bay, nothing like a big dealership: a children's off-road pit bike with plain white plastics and no graphics stands on a red paddock stand on the right of the frame, every part bolted in its correct place; a pegboard wall of hand tools and a red rolling tool chest behind; exactly two hands of one mechanic in black nitrile gloves, cropped at the forearms, tighten the rear axle nut with a wrench; dusty concrete floor; afternoon daylight entering through an open roller door on the left
